challenge.method: Check what is being sorted, who remains unscheduled, and the contrasting nonlocal signal subsection.
challenge.results: Direct audio-network cycles trigger the sort-time diagnostic and affected tilde objects can remain unscheduled. That does not imply all audio computation or feedback stops, or that the message-passing cycle rule is identical.

limitations: The review qualifies the direct sorted audio-network condition as documented. No runtime timing or signal measurements were performed.
